facts.statement: Free Realms ran a Presidents' Day weekend sale in which all Station Cash housing items and building lots were 50% off.
facts.quote: todos los artículos hogareños de Station Cash y terrenos para construir estarán a 50% de descuento

facts.statement: The sale began at noon on February 18 and ended at 23:59 PST on February 21, 2011.
facts.quote: Esta oferta iniciará a mediodía del 18 de febrero y terminara a las 23:59hrs. PST

article_summaries.title: ¡Venta de SOE en el Día de los Presidentes! (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official Free Realms news post announcing a Presidents' Day weekend sale in the in-game catalog. All Station Cash housing items and building lots were discounted 50% for a limited window ending February 21, 2011. The post names two housing lots as examples but gives no prices.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post announcing a Presidents' Day weekend sale: 50% off all Station Cash housing items and building lots. It gives the exact sale window (February 18 to February 21, 2011, ending 23:59 PST) and names two lots/houses as examples. The post itself is dated only as '3 months, 2 weeks ago' relative to the capture, so its exact posting date is unknown.
